fact: CAMTEL said at the SAGO conference of 9 June 2026 that its Zamengoe Data Centre is a critical national asset ensuring the security, continuity and local control of government data; the document does not list the specific systems hosted.

Speakers at Camtel's Cloud Days (10 December 2025) recalled that Cameroon's personal data protection law imposes strict requirements on consent, local storage and handlers' responsibilities; the document gives no law date or detail, so the date used is its publication date, 2025-12-11.
system: law on the protection of personal data

fact: Le Jour reports that the state, through Camtel, is building the Tier III Zamengoe data centre as a tool for a sovereign digital ecosystem, with the aim of producing and preserving data generated on national territory, as presented by Camtel director general Judith Yah Sunday at SAGO 2026.
